bca_jr_add_job_workforce_stats = {
    optimize_memory
    $TARGET_SCOPE$ = {
        add_variable = {
            which = $ASSIGNED_VAR$
            value = bca_jr_v_size
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = $CAPACITY_VAR$
            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = $PRODUCTIVE_VAR$
            value = bca_jr_v_productive
        }
    }
}

                has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_all_jobs
                has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_turtle_miner_gestalt
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_turtle_miner_gestalt
            value = modifier:job_turtle_miner_gestalt_add
        }
        export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
            trigger = free_jobs_of_type
            parameters = { job = turtle_miner_gestalt }
            variable = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_turtle_miner_gestalt
        }
    }

                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = bca_jr_v_size
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = value:bca_jr_workforce_capacity_mult_agri_drone

                            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = bca_jr_v_size
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = value:bca_jr_workforce_capacity_mult_translucer_drone
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_productive
                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_productive
                            value = value:bca_jr_output_efficiency_mult_translucer_drone
                        }

                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_assigned_workforce_translucer_drone
                            value = bca_jr_v_size
                        }
                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_translucer_drone
                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
                        }
                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_translucer_drone
                            value = bca_jr_v_productive
                        }
                    }
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_size
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_job_type = treasure_gatherer
                prev = {
                    OR = {
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_all_jobs
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_treasure_gatherer
                    }
                }
            }
            every_job_pop_group = {
                save_event_target_as = bca_jr_current_pop_group
                prev = { save_event_target_as = bca_jr_current_pop_job }
                colony = {
                    set_variable = {
                        which = bca_jr_v_size
                        value = value:bca_jr_num_pops_assigned_to_job|JOB|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_job|POP_GROUP|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_group|
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = bca_jr_v_size
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
                            value = value:bca_jr_workforce_capacity_mult_treasure_gatherer
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_productive
                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
                        }
                        multiply_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_v_productive
                            value = value:bca_jr_output_efficiency_mult_treasure_gatherer
                        }

                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_assigned_workforce_treasure_gatherer
                            value = bca_jr_v_size
                        }
                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_treasure_gatherer
                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
                        }
                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_treasure_gatherer
                            value = bca_jr_v_productive
                        }
                    }
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_size
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_job_type = treasure_gatherer_gestalt
                prev = {
                    OR = {
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_all_jobs
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_treasure_gatherer_gestalt

                }
            }
            every_job_pop_group = {
                save_event_target_as = bca_jr_current_pop_group
                prev = { save_event_target_as = bca_jr_current_pop_job }
                colony = {

                        which = bca_jr_v_size
                        value = value:bca_jr_num_pops_assigned_to_job|JOB|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_job|POP_GROUP|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_group|

                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }

                        set_variable = {

                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity

                        multiply_variable = {

                        add_variable = {

                            value = bca_jr_v_capacity

                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_treasure_gatherer_gestalt

                        }
                    }
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_size
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_job_type = turtle_miner_gestalt
                prev = {
                    OR = {
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_all_jobs
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_turtle_miner_gestalt

            every_job_pop_group = {

                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_job_type = wrangler
                prev = {
                    OR = {
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_all_jobs
                        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_check_wrangler
                    }
                }
            }
            every_job_pop_group = {
                save_event_target_as = bca_jr_current_pop_group

                    if = {

                            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }

                        }
                        add_variable = {

                        }
                        add_variable = {
                            which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_wrangler
                            value = bca_jr_v_productive
                        }
                    }
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_size
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
                    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable = bca_jr_tmp_job_count
}

bca_jr_finalize_job_stats = {
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_agri_drone
        value = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_agri_drone
    }
    add_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_agri_drone
        value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_agri_drone
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_agri_drone value > 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_agri_drone
            value = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_agri_drone

        divide_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_agri_drone
            value = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_agri_drone
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_agri_drone value = 1 }
    }
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_output_agri_drone_food
        value = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_agri_drone
    }
    multiply_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_output_agri_drone_food
